outcome: Clinical signs/symptoms of severe respiratory depression
cohort: The study included 20 obese (BMI >30 kg/m2), adult mothers who underwent Caesarean section with bupivacaine/morphine/fentanyl spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Portable polygraphy monitoring in early post-CS obese mothers with intrathecal opioids was cumbersome; while episodes of oxygen saturation decrease were noted, obstructive events and desaturation were commonly not synchronized, indicating upper airway obstructions were not of major importance in this setting.
